VIDEO | Chennai: Tamil Nadu has revised the school timetable to provide students with opportunities for physical education (PE) on all five working days of the week, School Education Minister Rajmohan said on Tuesday.

Under the revised schedule, three days a week will be dedicated to physical education, while schools can use periods allotted for extracurricular and co-curricular activities on the remaining two days for PE, if they choose to do so.

The minister said the change was made following long-standing demands from students, who had earlier been provided PE periods only twice a week. He said the revision was implemented on the instructions of CM Vijay.

item.description:
Russian Embassy in France on the seizure of the oil tanker DF Peak: piracy and a "blatant violation of international law."

Macron announced on October 12, 2026 that the French Navy intercepted and boarded the vessel 450 nautical miles south of Réunion Island in the Indian Ocean. Paris says the operation complied with international maritime law, citing suspicions of a false flag and "illicit fuel transportation" tied to Russia's shadow fleet.

Moscow says France gave no notification, calls the high seas boarding illegal, and is investigating whether Russian citizens were in the crew.

The DF Peak, formerly Kaliningrad and NS Captain, is a crude oil tanker affiliated with Sovcomflot. It sailed under a Benin flag that Western intelligence and maritime databases say was fraudulent.

It remains under French naval escort.

RIA.

item.title: VIDEO | Delhi: Addressing a press conference, Union Minister Piyush Goyal, says, "Over the past few days, we have witnessed Rahul Gandhi's conduct, th...
item.description:
VIDEO | Delhi: Addressing a press conference, Union Minister Piyush Goyal, says, "Over the past few days, we have witnessed Rahul Gandhi's conduct, the double standards in his actions, and what can only be described as childish behaviour that undermines every aspect of the Constitution. The NDA government has granted the Election Commission complete autonomy to function independently in the national and public interest. It has never attempted to offer political benefits to any appointed Election Commissioner. It has allowed them to work honestly and has never committed the wrongdoing of offering them political positions in violation of the legal provisions. However, if we look at Rahul Gandhi's track record, which he conveniently ignores, we find that the Congress appointed a Chief Election Commissioner as a candidate on its party ticket, inducted another into the Union Cabinet, and appointed two Chief Election Commissioners as Governors. On one occasion, despite the Chief Election Commissioner's complaint that an Election Commissioner working under him was acting entirely like a Congress agent, the Congress government refused to remove that official. We have rarely seen such a degree of bias in any government's conduct as the Congress has demonstrated. Let us begin with T. N. Seshan, who served as Chief Election Commissioner. The Congress used to praise his integrity and fearlessness. But what did it do afterwards? In 1999, it gave him the opportunity to contest on a Congress ticket against L. K. Advani. If he had been administering the electoral system with such integrity as an Election Commissioner, was fielding him as a party candidate in such an important election, against a leader like Advani, not a way of rewarding him? M. S. Gill served as Chief Election Commissioner for five years, from 1996 to 2001. Interestingly, he was awarded the Padma Vibhushan. In 2000, while he was still the sitting Chief Election Commissioner, he was conferred India's second-highest civilian honour. Was this not an inducement? Was it not, in effect, a form of bribery?"

#BJP #PiyushGoyal #RahulGandhi

VIDEO | Delhi: A delegation of women BJP MPs called on President Droupadi Murmu to draw her attention to the recent sacking of Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam as professor from the Jawaharlal Nehru University on sexual harassment charges. BJP Mahila Morcha chief Roop Kumari Choudhary, says, " The incident at JNU, Professor Bimol Akoijam, who is also a Congress MP from Manipur, allegedly misbehaved with 11 young women at the university. The women had submitted a written complaint, following which an internal committee was constituted to investigate the matter. The committee reportedly found him guilty, and he was dismissed from his position at the university. However, Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi and Sonia Gandhi have not uttered a word on the issue, despite claiming to stand for women's rights. They have remained silent. Priyanka Gandhi's slogan, 'Ladki Hoon, Lad Sakti Hoon' appears to be limited to just a slogan. Today, those young women are frightened and apprehensive because Dr Bimol is an influential Congress leader and enjoys the party's full support. The complainants are also afraid. We therefore approached the President of India to request that, since he continues to be a Lok Sabha MP, he should also be removed from Parliament. We also sought full protection for the young women who showed great courage in coming forward and filing the complaint, ensuring that they do not face any harm or intimidation in the future. We met the President with these requests, and she gave us assurances that she would have the matter investigated and ensure appropriate action at her level."

#BJP

The man who died, Daljeet, was a resident of Raghuvir Nagar. He is survived by his wife, eight-year-old son and father.

"The man had gone to the club with some of his friends and one of them spilled beer on a woman , which led to the fight. After the incident, the man went back home and suddenly took very ill. His wife took him to the hospital, where he died," Niharika Bhatt, DCP North of Delhi Police said.

She said "We have arrested 5 people for the murder of a young man in Sarai Rohilla. The arrested people are the manager of a bar, his wife and 3 bouncers."

item.description:
VIDEO | Tamil Nadu: Farmers staged a road blockade on the Tiruchirappalli-Thanjavur National Highway on Tuesday, demanding the immediate release of irrigation water into the New Command Mettur Canal, disrupting traffic on both sides. The protest followed the failure of three rounds of reconciliation talks on the release of water into the canal, leaving farmers frustrated.

Although the Mettur Dam was opened for irrigation in the delta districts about a month ago, water has not reached the extension canals running from Mayanur in Karur district towards Thanjavur, including the Uyyakondan extension canal and the New Command Mettur Canal. Farmers from around 20 villages, including Asur, Poiyangudi, Vallam Pudur, Palayapatti, Kurumboondi and Achampatti, have been affected by the delay. They said they were unable to begin cultivation on around 27,000 acres due to the lack of irrigation water.

RT PIB India
Khadi & Village Industries: From Tradition to Enterprise

🔹A charkha spinning in a village once spoke of nationalism. Today, that spirit is taking new shape through a growing ecosystem of rural enterprises. Honey, herbal products, banana fibre, textiles and other village industries are creating new possibilities for traditional skills.

🔹The spirit of self-reliance continues to resonate with the vision of Vocal for Local and Atmanirbhar Bharat. Traditional skills and local resources are finding new markets through access to finance, technology and training.

🔹This growing connection between local enterprise and consumers is also reflected in the Khadi Mahotsav. The Khadi Mahotsav takes place annually from 2 October to 31 October. With a particular focus on youth, the campaign sensitises them towards Khadi and “Vocal for Local” and encourages the public to buy Khadi and local products.

🔹At the centre of this transformation is the Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC). It is a statutory body established under the Khadi and Village Industries Commission Act, 1956. The Act mandates KVIC to plan, promote, facilitate, organise and assist village industries.

🔹It covers measures related to training, raw materials, marketing, research, and quality improvement. It also supports skill development and research, while providing technical information and facilities related to Khadi and village industries.

For more details, read here: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2322625
